name: p4-dual
purpose: Measured-first path to a better 1- or 2-board model. Independent review 2026-08-15 rejected opening with a 58-expert from-scratch run.

hop_protocol.do_not_flash: sun weights; app-flash hop firmware only when COM5 is plugged

commands.LLMHOP05: token, position, layer_begin, layer_end, score_output, flags, f32[192] hidden -> LLMHOK05
commands.LLMHSL05: on-device split vs full token_step loopback

hop_protocol.two_board: python runtime/host/hop_two_boards.py (needs hop firmware on Sun)

phase_24l.name: depth-upcycle reconstructed original to 24 layers, FineWeb continue, top-1
phase_24l.note: Do not export or flash until GPU greedy+val beat reconstructed original. Then split layers 0-11 Sun, 12-23 Mercury.

phase_a_run.note: Do not flash Sun. GPU greedy vs reconstructed original after ALL_DONE.

prerequisites.reconstruct_original_pt: import_aircraft.py from pfor-180m.llmcraft; re-export SHA and greedy match vs Sun
prerequisites.gpu_baseline: held-out val loss + greedy 5-prompt set of the reconstructed original
prerequisites.sun_stage_profile: LLMPRQ05 dump; needs firmware LLMM_DEBUG=1. Go/no-go for expert RPC: decode expert_ms vs 12 * RTT
prerequisites.mercury_ethernet_rtt: 192-byte echo x12 under decode load; p50/p99. Switch required. mercury.eth_ip is currently null
prerequisites.train_throughput: tokens/sec at seq 256 and 1024 on 170HX; FineWeb 1B was ~154k tok/s at seq 1024 (28,408 steps in ~1h41m)

phase_a.name: single-board top-2 on reconstructed original
phase_a.why: Doubles active FFN. Byte accounting says the 12 routed experts are ~9% of ~7.5 MB/token (Q8 head is 6.29 MB), so decode cost is likely +10-25% not 2x. Measure with expert/output_head profile. No RPC, no second board, no new artifact.
phase_a.gate: GPU greedy + val loss must beat reconstructed original before any flash

phase_b.name: two-board decision
phase_b.when: after phase A numbers and measured RTT/profile

expert_shard.router: grouped-top2 with per-group softmax and per-group balance loss
expert_shard.note: grouped top-2 is a constrained subset of unconstrained top-2; measure the gap on GPU first. 58 experts cannot fit in 32 MB PSRAM.

layer_pipeline.tradeoff: 1 RTT/token, ~7 MB flash and ~10 MB PSRAM freed per board, ~2x decode for 2x depth

boards.sun: coordinator: embeddings, attention, KV, PLE, routers
boards.mercury: worker role depends on phase B choice

do_not: split the existing 29 experts across two boards for accuracy
fill PSRAM with a knowledge pack and 29 experts at once
score ChatML Q&A until after SFT
flash Sun until GPU beats the reconstructed original

lessons_from_fineweb_1b.capability_plan_does_not_mix_data: train.py uses capability-pretraining-plan.json only for LR schedule and seq-len asserts; selection blocks are unused. dclm/pes2o/finemath/python_edu/wikipedia have no pretraining.json entries.

training_notes.lr: 3e-4 needs retune if global batch grows
training_notes.sft: sft-v2 after a winning pretrain, with DCLM replay

measured.profile_blocked: production firmware has LLMM_DEBUG=0; LLMPRQ05 is unknown and desyncs the TCP session. dump_profile.py is ready after a debug rebuild (Mercury only).
measured.hop_decision: 1-hop layer split is ~3% of decode; 12-hop expert RPC is ~30%. Do layer pipeline first.

layer_pipeline_mercury.note: Exact hidden match vs full token_step. Sun not flashed. Same 180.9M weights; Mercury still holds the full net.

measured.tokens_per_sec_note: FineWeb steps 200-28408: 09:51 to 11:31 (~100 min), ~4.3 step/s * 32 * 1024. First step 66s (compile). 12B tokens at this rate ~22 hours.
